description: Fetch today's ComputePrep drill (IBPS PO/Clerk · SBI PO/Clerk · SSC CGL/CHSL quantitative aptitude). Every conversation receives this same question, already checked to have one correct answer. Returns the exam, the difficulty and the expected time in seconds. Does not return the answer or the worked explanation. Pass lang hi for Hindi. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

attemptId.description: Conversation id returned by get_daily_drill on ComputePrep. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. Pass this same id on every later call in the conversation.

lang.description: Optional. en (default) or hi. Hindi is the question's own Hindi text, served only while this server's language switch is on.

name: get_daily_drill
title: Today's quant drill
